body.p: This paper is in response to the Restriction Requirement, mailed December 1, 2023 in which the Examiner has required restriction between the following:
Species I, (Fig. 2-6) - wherein the fastening system comprises a wall portion

(22c) with a first fastening element (24) that engages with a second fastening element (26) of a frame (20), wherein a locking unit (56, 56a, 56b) of the fastening system comprises blocking elements (62,72) which are received in aligned openings
(58 and 60, 68 and 70 in Fig. 2-4; 58a and 60a in Fig. 5);
Species II, (Fig. 7-8) - wherein the fastening system comprises a wall portion

(22c) engaged with a frame (20c), wherein a locking unit (56c) of the fastening system comprises blocking elements (62c) arranged on a bar (80c), wherein the blocking elements are configures to be received in lugs (74c) of the frame. An actuation mechanism (75c) is provided at the end of the bar comprising a spring element (78c) and an actuation member (76c), wherein application of a force to the actuation mechanism in a direction of the spring causes the locking unit to transition
from a locked state (Fig. 7) to an unlocked state (Fig. 8); and
Species III, (Fig. 9-10) - wherein the fastening system comprises a wall

portion (22d) that received a fixture (16d) within a receiving region (50d) of the wall portion, wherein a connecting element (90d) of the fixture is received within a socket (92d) of the wall portion and wherein no frame is present within the fastening
system to retain the fixture.

Applicant hereby elects, without traverse, Species 1. Applicant submits that claims 1-9 and 12-17 are directed towards the elected Species. As indicated above, claims 10 and 11 have been withdrawn. Applicant reserves the right to rejoin these claims or file a divisional application which contains these claims.
In view of the foregoing, it is believed that the present application is in condition for substantive examination.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required to this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 07-2069.
Should the Examiner discover there are remaining issues which may be resolved by a telephone interview, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney at (312) 987-2927.
